legend_drawing_text: Table S8 Sample metadata, compound information and proteomic

Sample-level metadata for the PTPC dataset, an independent perturbation proteomics dataset generated across five cancer cell lines (A375, HCT116, NCI-H1975, NCI-H2170 and Panc 10.05). Proteomic profiles were collected at 6 h and 24 h after treatment, with control samples assigned a perturbation time of 0 h. This table lists 2217 non-pooled samples, comprising 2021 independent proteomic samples and 196 technical or biological replicates. The 90 pooled samples are included in the total PTPC sample count but are not listed in this table. After accounting for pooled and replicate samples, PTPC contained 2021 independent proteomic samples for model evaluation.

Compound information for the 716 perturbation identifiers used in PTPC, corresponding to 708 unique compound names. All compounds were purchased from TargetMol. Information includes perturbation ID, catalog number, compound name, CAS number, SMILES, molecular formula, pathway annotations, indication, solvent, target annotations and compound type.

Matched protein abundance matrix for the same 2217 non-pooled sample records. Rows correspond to samples and columns correspond to quantified proteins annotated by UniProt accession and and gene name concatenated with an underscore (e.g., A0A1B0GUA7_TEX51).
